about: Words the Barker refuses to read out. 'party' applies in every room; 'classroom' is added on top in Classroom mode. Add plain lowercase words to either list; simple endings (s, es, ed, ing, er, ers, in, y) are caught too. 'rot13' holds the base profanity and slur list, ROT13-encoded so the file stays readable; leave it as it is.
